title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Arbitrary file deletion via path traversal in CSS editor in Visforms extension…
description: A path traversal vulnerability in the CSS editor of the Visforms Joomla extension (versions 1.0.0-5.6.3 and 6.0.0-6.2.0) allows authenticated backend users to delete arbitrary files outside the intended CSS directory. The delete and rename functions lack authorization checks, CSRF protection, and path validation.
